meta.title: Simple Bank — Banking Made Simple
meta.description: Open an account, add money, and send it to anyone in seconds. A free demo banking app built to show how simple, accurate banking can feel.

nav.exploreDescription: A quick look at how we keep your money safe and accurate.

hero.description: Simple Bank lets you hold money in more than one account, add funds, and send money to anyone — quickly and accurately, every time. It's a free demo, so you can try it all out with practice money first.
hero.note: This demo uses practice money, but every account, deposit, and transfer works exactly the way it would in a real banking app.

overview.title: A demo bank you can actually use.

what.title: What is Simple Bank?
what.body: Simple Bank lets you register, open more than one account, add money, and send it to other accounts, all in one simple app. Every transaction is recorded carefully, so your balance is always accurate, down to the cent.

why.title: Why we built it
why.body: We wanted to build something that treats money the way it deserves to be treated: carefully. Nothing here gets lost, guessed at, or rounded off. Every deposit and transfer is tracked precisely, so you can always trust the numbers you see.

demonstrates.title: What you can do
items: Open multiple accounts in one place
Add money whenever you need to
See exactly where every cent went
Trust that your balance is always right
Use the app in English or Indonesian
Pick up right where you left off, on any device

journey.title: From your tap to your balance updating.
journey.subtitle: Here's what actually happens behind the scenes, in plain terms. Pick a step to learn more.

steps.title: What you need
steps.detail: Just the essentials: manage your accounts, add money, and send it to others — done properly, instead of a long list of features done halfway.

steps.title: The app you use
steps.detail: Every screen reacts quickly and only asks for what it actually needs, whether you're adding money or checking a balance.

steps.title: Talking to our systems
steps.detail: Everything you do in the app is sent securely to the system that keeps your accounts, so you're always looking at real, up-to-date information.

steps.title: Checking every request
steps.detail: Every action you take — a deposit, a transfer, an account change — is checked and verified before anything happens to your money.

steps.title: The rules that protect you
steps.detail: We make sure you have enough money before a transfer goes through, that amounts are never negative, and that money never gets counted twice.

steps.title: Where your records live
steps.detail: Every account and transaction is stored carefully, so your history is always there when you need to look back at it.

steps.title: Always ready
steps.detail: The systems behind Simple Bank are built to stay up and respond quickly, so the app is there whenever you need it.

steps.title: Getting updates safely
steps.detail: Every improvement we make is tested first, so updates happen without disrupting your accounts or your money.

frontend.title: Designed to feel simple, every time.
frontend.subtitle: Every screen in the app follows the same careful path from your action to an updated balance.

steps.title: You fill out a form
steps.detail: Whether you're adding money or sending a transfer, forms are short and only ask for what's actually needed.

steps.title: We check it right away
steps.detail: If something doesn't look right — a missing field, an invalid amount — we tell you immediately, in plain language, instead of after you've waited.

steps.title: Your info loads instantly
steps.detail: The app remembers what you've already seen, so moving between screens feels instant instead of reloading everything each time.

steps.title: One safe path for every request
steps.detail: Every action in the app, big or small, goes through the exact same careful process, so nothing gets special treatment or skipped.

steps.title: Every request is protected
steps.detail: The app quietly confirms it's really you before sending any request, and keeps a record of what happened in case anything needs to be looked into.

steps.title: The real work happens safely
steps.summary: Your money's rules live in one place
steps.detail: Balances, transfers, and ownership are all decided in one trusted place, so the rules are never duplicated or out of sync.

prefetch.label: Loads instantly
prefetch.description: Pages show your real information the moment they open — no spinner, no waiting for data to catch up.

notes: Every screen shows real, accurate information. If something changes on our end, you'll never be shown outdated numbers by mistake.
The parts of the app you interact with and the parts that remember your information are kept separate, so a glitch in one never affects the other.

backend.title: What happens the moment you tap a button.
backend.subtitle: Every request goes through the same careful checks, in the same order, every single time.

steps.title: Your request arrives
steps.detail: Whatever you do in the app — a deposit, a transfer — arrives at our system as a clear, well-formed request.

steps.title: It gets a tracking number
steps.detail: Every request gets its own reference, so if anything ever needs investigating, we can trace exactly what happened, step by step.

steps.title: It's logged
steps.detail: We keep a careful record of what happened and when, with anything sensitive, like passwords, automatically hidden from those records.

steps.title: Only trusted sources allowed
steps.detail: Requests are only accepted from the actual Simple Bank app, not from some other website pretending to be it.

steps.title: Errors are caught safely
steps.detail: If something unexpected happens, we catch it immediately and make sure you get a clear answer instead of an app that just breaks.

steps.title: Nothing crashes silently
steps.detail: Even if something goes wrong on our end, you'll always get a proper response, never a frozen screen or a request that just vanishes.

steps.title: We confirm it's you
steps.detail: Before we touch your accounts, we double-check that the request is really coming from you, signed in and verified.

steps.title: We double-check the details
steps.detail: Amounts, account numbers, and every other detail are verified against clear rules before anything is accepted.

steps.title: The actual work happens
steps.detail: This is where your balance actually changes, always inside a safeguard that makes sure it either fully happens or doesn't happen at all.

steps.title: You get your answer
steps.detail: You get a clear confirmation when something works, and a clear, honest explanation when it doesn't.

banking.title: Every cent is tracked, never just overwritten.
banking.subtitle: When you send money, we don't just change two numbers. We record exactly what happened, so nothing is ever lost, duplicated, or unaccounted for.

lockCallout.title: Why we're careful about the order we work in
lockCallout.body: If two transfers between the same two accounts happen at the exact same moment, we make sure they're handled one after another, in a consistent, predictable order — never at random. That way, two things happening at once can never trip each other up or leave your balance wrong.

steps.title: We check the basics
steps.detail: We make sure you're not sending money to yourself and that the amount actually makes sense — nothing happens until that's confirmed.

steps.title: We lock things down
steps.detail: While your transfer is happening, both accounts involved are temporarily protected from any other change, so nothing can interfere.

steps.title: We check you can afford it
steps.detail: If there isn't enough money, or the accounts don't use the same currency, the transfer stops right here, before anything is touched.

steps.title: We record the transfer
steps.detail: A record is created noting exactly which accounts were involved, and how much moved between them.

steps.title: Money leaves the sender
steps.detail: We write down exactly what left the sending account, a permanent record, not just a number that quietly changed.

steps.title: Money arrives for the receiver
steps.detail: We write down exactly what arrived in the receiving account, matched to the same transfer.

steps.title: It's final
steps.detail: If any part of this had failed, none of it would have happened. You'll never end up with money that left one account but never arrived in another.

notes: Your money is never treated as a rough estimate. Every amount is handled with exact precision, down to the cent, never rounded, never approximated.
Closing an account with money in it doesn't make that money disappear. It's automatically moved to your main account first, safely and on the record.
Every new customer automatically gets one main account the moment they sign up, guaranteed, not just something we try to remember to do.

database.title: Every account, every transaction, organized and accurate.
database.subtitle: We don't just keep a single balance number for your account. We keep the full history behind it, so it can always be checked and never just taken on faith.

relationships: You can hold several accounts, and exactly one of them is always your main account.
Every account builds up a full transaction history. Your balance is simply the total of everything that's ever happened to it.

A transfer can never be for zero or a negative amount. It simply can't exist as a record.
You'll always have exactly one main account, never zero, and never more than one.

api.title: One clear set of rules, followed everywhere.
api.subtitle: Every request you make follows the same simple pattern, and gets one of two kinds of answer back.

security.title: Real protections, not just a promise.
security.subtitle: Here's exactly what keeps your account and your money safe, and what we're still honest about improving.

cards.title: Secure sign-in
cards.body: When you sign in, you get a secure, time-limited pass that proves it's you, without ever storing your password anywhere it could be exposed.

cards.title: Everything is checked
cards.body: Every piece of information you send, amounts, account numbers, passwords, is checked carefully before we act on it, catching mistakes before they become problems.

cards.title: Only trusted visitors
cards.body: Simple Bank only accepts requests from its own app, never from an unknown website pretending to be us.

cards.title: Nothing fails silently
cards.body: If something ever goes wrong on our end, it's caught immediately, logged, and handled. You'll always get a clear answer, never a broken screen.

cards.title: Your money is protected mid-transfer
cards.body: Every deposit, transfer, or account change happens as one safe, all-or-nothing step, so your balance is never left half-updated.

cards.title: Honest about the trade-offs
cards.body: This demo keeps you signed in in a way that's simple rather than maximally locked-down, a deliberate, known trade-off for a demo project, not something we're hiding.

infrastructure.title: From an idea to something you can actually use.
infrastructure.subtitle: Here's how Simple Bank goes from a change we make to something running and available to you.

steps.title: Everything starts as one clear plan
steps.detail: The app you use and the system behind it are built and tracked together, but kept independent, so a change to one never accidentally breaks the other.

steps.title: Every change is tested first
steps.detail: Before any update goes live, it's automatically checked against a real, working copy of the system, the same way it would be checked by a real bank's engineering team.

steps.title: Packaged consistently
steps.detail: The system is packaged the same exact way every time it's built, so what gets tested is exactly what actually runs, no surprises in between.

steps.title: Runs the same everywhere
steps.summary: No surprises between testing and real use
steps.detail: The pieces that make up Simple Bank are set up to run together consistently, whether that's while building it or while it's live for you to use.

steps.title: Changes to your records are tracked
steps.detail: Any change to how your information is stored is planned, recorded, and reversible, never a quiet, undocumented edit.

steps.title: Set up carefully, not by hand
steps.detail: The servers that run Simple Bank are set up in a controlled, repeatable way, so nothing about how they're configured is left to guesswork.

steps.title: Kept separate for your safety
steps.detail: The app you use and the system holding your data are deployed separately, and only ever talk to each other over one clearly locked-down connection.

notes: We keep clear records of what happens on our systems, with a traceable reference for every request, so if something ever needs investigating, we can look into it properly.
However Simple Bank is running, whether on a laptop while we're building it or live for you to use, it behaves exactly the same way, so you never get a different experience than what we tested.

decisions.title: A few honest trade-offs.
decisions.subtitle: We won't pretend everything here is perfect. Here's where we made a deliberate choice, and why.

labels.constraint: What we had to work with

items.problem: If two transfers involving the same two accounts happen at the exact same moment, they could get tangled up with each other.
items.constraint: Both accounts involved in a transfer need to be protected from other changes while it's happening.
items.decision: We always handle those accounts in the same consistent order, no matter which direction the money is moving.
items.result: Two transfers happening at once will never get stuck or conflict. Your money always moves cleanly, even under heavy use.

items.problem: Computers can sometimes round money incorrectly, which is never okay when it's your actual balance.
items.constraint: Every amount needs to stay exact through every step, no matter how many times it's stored, sent, or calculated.
items.decision: We treat every amount as an exact value from start to finish, never as an approximation.
items.result: Your balance is always exactly right, down to the cent, with no rounding errors, ever.

items.problem: Closing an account that still has money in it shouldn't make that money disappear, but it also shouldn't block you from closing the account.
items.constraint: Money can move between accounts, but it can never just vanish.
items.decision: When you close an account, any remaining balance is automatically and safely moved to your main account first, as a real, recorded transfer.
items.result: You can close an account anytime, and every cent in it is accounted for and preserved.

items.problem: The app needs to prove it's really you before it acts on your behalf, even when you're using it in a browser.
items.constraint: This demo doesn't yet have a more advanced setup that would keep that proof completely hidden from the browser.
items.decision: For now, this demo uses a simpler approach to keep you signed in.
items.result: It's simple and it works well for a demo. We're upfront that a more locked-down version of this is a planned improvement, not something we're ignoring.

requestFlow.title: What happens when you send money.
requestFlow.subtitle: One real example, from the moment you tap "Send" to your balance updating. Pick a step to see more.

steps.title: You fill in the details
steps.detail: You choose an account, an amount, and where it's going, and we check it looks right before you can even hit send.

steps.title: You hit send
steps.detail: Your request is packaged up and sent off securely, right away.

steps.title: It reaches our system
steps.detail: Your transfer request arrives at the system that manages every account, ready to be checked and processed.

steps.title: It passes every check
steps.detail: Before your transfer touches any money, we confirm it's really you, and that everything about the request is safe and valid.

steps.title: We double-check the details
steps.detail: We confirm you actually own the account you're sending from, that the amount makes sense, and that you're not sending money to yourself.

steps.title: The transfer happens
steps.detail: Both accounts are protected for a moment while we check you have enough money and the currencies match.

steps.title: It's recorded, permanently
steps.detail: We write down exactly what left one account and what arrived in the other, and update both balances together, completely, or not at all.

steps.title: You get confirmation
steps.detail: You get a clear answer back the moment it's done, letting you know your transfer went through.

steps.title: Your numbers refresh
steps.detail: The app quietly knows your balances just changed, so it goes and gets the latest numbers.

steps.title: You see it update
steps.detail: Your balance and transaction history update right in front of you, with nothing for you to do.

capabilities.title: What Simple Bank actually does for you.

items.title: Fast, focused screens
items.body: The app only shows you what you need, and reacts instantly, without unnecessary loading.

items.title: Accurate, real-time information
items.body: What you see on screen always matches what's really in your account.

items.title: Clear, helpful forms
items.body: If something's wrong with what you entered, you'll know immediately, in plain language.

items.title: Careful, layered checks
items.body: Every request goes through the same trusted process, with no shortcuts and nothing skipped.

items.title: Secure sign-in
items.body: You're verified on every request, so your account can't be touched by anyone but you.

items.title: Clear answers, even when something goes wrong
items.body: You'll never be left guessing. Errors are handled consistently and explained clearly.

items.title: Exact records, always
items.body: Your data is handled with careful precision, nothing is left to guesswork or rounded off.

items.title: A full, permanent history
items.body: Your balance isn't just a number. It's the sum of a complete, unchangeable history you can always look back on.

items.title: Every change is tracked
items.body: Every update to how records are stored is documented and reversible, so nothing about your data changes by surprise.

items.title: Packaged for consistency
items.body: The system runs the same way every time, so nothing behaves differently between testing and real use.

items.title: Set up carefully, not by hand
items.body: The servers behind Simple Bank are configured in a controlled, repeatable way, not clicked together and hoped for.

items.title: Independent, locked-down connections
items.body: The app you use and the system holding your data are kept separate, connected only through one clearly controlled channel.

items.title: Tested before it ships
items.body: Changes are checked against real conditions before they ever reach you.

items.title: Checked on every update
items.body: Every single change is automatically tested against a real, working system before it's considered done.

items.title: Honest, up front
items.body: We tell you plainly where something is a known trade-off instead of pretending everything is perfect.
